lead.event: BEI excludes high-shareholding-concentration stocks from IHSG calculation
lead.headline: BEI excludes 81 high-shareholding-concentration stocks from IHSG calculation
lead.blurb: The change took effect on 2 November, when the IHSG opened down 1.41% at 4,981. The stocks remain tradable but no longer affect the index, which now counts 837 stocks. BEI redistributed their roughly 18.41% index weight among the remaining constituents.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: regrouped, 1 of its articles moved out

market_structure_policy.event: Minister Bahlil orders direct resource exports and coal production cuts
market_structure_policy.headline: Bahlil orders direct exports and coal production cuts as Indonesia supplies 43% of coal trade
market_structure_policy.blurb: He directed mining and oil and gas officials to route coal, LNG and other resource shipments directly from Indonesia to markets including China, Japan and South Korea, not through intermediaries. Bahlil also announced lower RKAB allocations for mining companies to manage supply and demand, with Indonesia contributing 540 million tons of global traded coal in 2025.

deals_control.event: BYAN plans board changes following a major share transfer
deals_control.headline: BYAN plans board changes after 10 billion-share acquisition
deals_control.blurb: Andi Syamsuddin Arsyad, known as Haji Isam, acquired the shares through Jhonlin Baratama, which signed a conditional sale agreement with founders Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low on 16 September. Shareholders will vote on changes to the Board of Directors and Commissioners at an extraordinary meeting on 23 November.

earnings_guidance.event: Amman Mineral reports strong nine-month profit and sales
earnings_guidance.headline: AMMN reports US$880 million nine-month profit as sales rise 494%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Amman Mineral swung from a US$175 million loss a year earlier. Sales comprised US$1.38 billion from copper cathode, US$1.08 billion from concentrate and US$772 million from pure gold. Copper cathode output reached 102,000 tons by 28 September, against a 2026 target of 130,000 tons.

earnings_guidance.event: OMED reports strong nine-month sales and raises its 2026 revenue target
earnings_guidance.headline: OMED raises 2026 revenue target to around Rp2.5 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Jayamas Medica's nine-month EBITDA rose 34.0% to Rp426 billion, while net sales increased 26.1% to Rp1.85 trillion. It lifted its previous Rp2.3 trillion revenue target after sales-volume growth and production efficiency, leaving other guidance unchanged, including gross margin in the early 30% range.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: OMED's nine-month EBITDA rose 34.0% to Rp426 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Pool Advista Finance reports a third-quarter loss

earnings_guidance.blurb: Pool Advista Finance swung from a Rp7.23 billion profit a year earlier as revenue fell 50.58% to Rp9.83 billion. Expenses declined 7.57% to Rp10.98 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Danantara Investment Management reports profit through April 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: Danantara Investment Management reports Rp705.73 billion profit through April
earnings_guidance.blurb: The investment institution formed by President Prabowo Subianto reversed a Rp131 million net loss a year earlier. First-quarter revenue reached Rp1.10 trillion, while finance expenses rose 119.00% to Rp1.01 trillion.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: MBMA seeks approval for a private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MBMA seeks approval for private placement of up to 10.79 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Merdeka Battery Materials will put the proposal to shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting on 8 December. The new shares would have a Rp100 nominal value each and could increase paid-in capital by up to 10%, with the company aiming to strengthen its capital structure.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: RAJA reports profit growth alongside a bond and sukuk offering
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: RAJA reports 82% nine-month profit growth alongside bond and sukuk offering
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Rukun Raharja reported US$43.8 million in net profit, while demand for its Phase I offer was indicated at around Rp1.20 trillion. The offer comprises Rp1.01 trillion in bonds and Rp191.6 billion in sukuk, with listing planned for 11 November.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: RAJA reported nine-month net profit of US$43.8 million, with offering demand indicated at around Rp1.20 trillion.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Champion Pacific prepares a share buyback for a proposed delisting
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: IGAR prepares Rp163.44 billion buyback for proposed delisting
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Champion Pacific plans to repurchase 155.66 million shares, or 16.78% of its issued and paid-up shares, at Rp1,050 each using internal cash. Shareholders will vote on the plan at an extraordinary meeting on 9 December, after which the company plans to delist from the Indonesia Stock Exchange.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: PART plans a rights issue of up to eight billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: PART plans rights issue of up to 8 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Cipta Perdana would issue shares at a nominal value of Rp25 each, with a maximum nominal value of Rp200 billion. It plans to use the proceeds for working capital, including raw material purchases, supplier payments and operating costs. The plan requires shareholder approval on 9 December and an OJK effective statement.
